floods.what: The area flooded. It was called the worst in 10 years at the time.
Seksyen 25 flooded, water a little over 1 m.
floods.source: DOSM newsletter, citing the New Straits Times; Free Malaysia Today, 1 Jan 2022

floods.what: One resident recalls her house was flooded for four days.
floods.source: Free Malaysia Today, 14 Apr 2025, one person's account

floods.what: The river rose over the bund and most homes and shops flooded, after more than 150 mm of rain.
The big flood. Depth was reported as over six feet, and later as over 4 m. We found no published survey.

floods.source: Rosmadi and others 2025, quoting MBSA's flood report for 2022
